name: Rad Shiba
source:
Rad Shiba is a Shiba Inu dog who "works" part time at VA-11 Hall-A, although most of the time he's treated as a patron. His boss is Nacho Tumbleweed Jr. from the Canine Independent Rescue Association.

His name isn't actually Rad Shiba, but for some reason, Dana is insistent that, regardless of what his name is, “His name is Rad Shiba!”
